description: This file defines the HashingStream class, which decorates a stream to calculate a rolling hash as data is read from it. It is part of the AWS SDK's storage component, providing functionality for hash calculation during stream processing.

classes.name: HashingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that computes a hash of the data read from the underlying stream, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HashingStream with a stream to read from, a hash object, and an optional callback to invoke when hashing is complete.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the underlying stream, updates the hash with the data, and calls the completion callback if the end of the stream is reached.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Resets the hash and seeks the underlying stream to a specified offset, currently supporting only offset zero.
